GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY - FORM 10-K FOR 2017 (fixture excerpt; see README Part 6)

(In millions; per-share amounts in dollars)

LONG-TERM PRODUCT SERVICE AGREEMENTS. Revisions may affect a product services agreement’s total estimated profitability resulting in an adjustment of earnings; such adjustments increased earnings by $2.1 billion, $2.2 billion and $1.4 billion for the years ended December 31, 2017, 2016 and 2015, respectively.

Contract assets increased $3,699 million in 2017, which was primarily driven by a change in estimated profitability of $2,131 million within our long-term product service agreements within Power.

Cash used for contract assets of $3.9 billion in 2016 compared with $1.9 billion in 2015, primarily due to cumulative catch up adjustments driven by lower forecasted cost to complete the contracts.
